issues.description: Method getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents: the UML diagram in the problem statement (problem_statement.md) declares the method as returning void, while the textual task description and the reference implementation return a String. Specifically, problem_statement.md line 71 shows '+getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): void', but solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java defines 'public String getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents()'. This inconsistency can confuse students about the correct return type to implement and may lead to incorrect implementations or failing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML diagram in problem_statement.md to declare getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String to match the textual description and the reference implementation.
